gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
The company was ___ up by a larger rival last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Take over/take up a company' — here 'was taken up' = absorbed by a bigger firm.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.
